name: jfduke3d-vita
author: Rinnegatamante
description:
jfduke3d-vita is a port of JFDuke3D, a popular multi-platform source port of Duke Nukem 3D.
It supports both shareware and full game data files as well as full game data files of NAM.
This port implements both classic 8 bit renderer and the new 32 bit Polymost renderer with hardware acceleration through vitaGL.
